lightIdle: Thayipha nanyana yikuphi ikheli lewebhusayithi. Sihlola uhlu lwethu lwezinsongo, isakhiwo, ukulingisa iimpawu, i-DNS nempendulo ekhona nje. Ku-Misa: phuma, qinisekisa ngesiteshi esisemthethweni osesithembako, bese ubika nanyana ufuna.
lightLimited: Kuhle kusitjho bonyana ukuhlola okwenziwe akuzange kube nesexwayiso esinamandla — akusona isithembiso sokuthi isayithi iphephile.
privacyNote: Okuhlala kukhona: akugcinwa luthu. Ukuhlola amaphutha kusiza ukulungisa iinkinga zobuchwepheshe kuphela — soze kube yikheli, begodu soze kube ukukhishwa emphakathini.
privacyPolicyIntro: I-buusdo Cybersecurity Service Tool (umugqa wemikhiqizo we-Buusdo — umkhiqizo ohlukileko) ikusiza ukuthi uhlola ikheli lewebhusayithi ngaphambi kokuthi ulithembe. Ukuhlola kusetjenziswa iimpawu zethu uqobo nohlu lwethu lwezinsongo oluqondisiweko. Leli khasi yisaziso semfihlo somkhiqizo sewebhusayithi, i-extension yesiphequluli, ne-app yedeskithophu.
privacyPolicyWhatBody: Nanyana uqalisa ukuhlola, ikheli olifakako licutjhungulwa kuseva ye-buusdo ukuze kuhlaziywe isakhiwo, kufaniswe nohlu lwethu lwezinsongo, begodu ngokukhetha kuhlolwe ukufinyeleleka okukhona nje (i-DNS / i-HTTP). Asithumeli ama-URL ahloliweko ku-Google Safe Browsing nanyana kwamanye ama-API edumela wenkampani yesithathu, begodu asithengisi idatha yokuhlola.
privacyPolicyStoreBody: Okuhlala kukhona: akugcinwa luthu. Ungakhetha ukugcina kule divayisi kuphela (uhlu lokuvimbela/lokuthemba, umlando wokuhlola ongawukhetha) kusiphequluli, ku-extension, nanyana ku-app yedeskithophu. Ukuhlola amaphutha kokusekela okukhethako kufaka umthombo nohlobo lwensongo kuphela — soze kube yikheli eligcweleko, begodu soze kube ukukhishwa emphakathini nanyana ukukhangisa.
privacyPolicyAccountBody: I-buusdo ayiniki i-akhawunti yefu nanyana ukuvumelanisa kohlu phakathi kwamadivayisi. Uhlu lwakho lokuvimbela/lokuthemba luhlala kule divayisi. Luhambise ngokukhipha/ukungenisa i-JSON nanyana i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1, nanyana uvumelanise wena ifayela le-shield-backup.json yedeskithophu (i-USB, i-Drive, i-Syncthing).
privacyPolicyContactBody: Ngemibuzo yemfihlo nanyana yomkhiqizo, xhumana nomsebenzi wokumisa kwakho kwe-buusdo nge-imeyili yakhe esemthethweni nanyana ngesiteshi sokusekela (umuntu nanyana inhlangano eqhuba i-Cloudflare Worker). Khetha lelo kheli elisemthethweni oselazi — hhayi ucingo nanyana i-imeyili eprintweko kusayithi oyihlolako. Unganamathiseli imiphumela yokuhlola ebucayi eziteshini zomphakathi.
privacyPolicyLimitsBody: Akukho ukukhishwa kwe-TLS — i-HTTPS CONNECT yigama lomshini kuphela; akukho sitifiketi se-MITM. Akukho ukubulawa kweenqubo — iinhlelo ezisebenzako ziyaqhubeka. Iinkomba zesistimu ziyabikwa kuphela — /usr, /etc, iindlela zesistimu ze-Windows, ne-Program Files azisoze zisuswe nanyana zihlelwe. Akukho injini ye-AV nanyana yamasignesha, begodu akukho ukubanjwa kwamaphasiwedi nanyana umlando wokuphequlula.
desktopDownloadsIntro: Faka i-buusdo kule khompyutha ukusuka ku-GitHub Release (igobolondo lesiphequluli + ithreyi). Izakhiwo azisayiniwe — bheka umhlahlandlela wokusetha. Ukuvula nanyana ungena kuhlala kucinyiwe kuze kube uyikhipha.
desktopDownloadUnsignedUntilPromote: Isakhiwo esingasayiniweko (asinganotari). I-macOS ingavimbela ukuvula kokuqala — landela umhlahlandlela wokusetha (i-xattr / Privacy & Security). I-Windows SmartScreen ingaxwayisa ngoMshicileli ongaziwako.
desktopDownloadReadyToPromote: Inothi elidala: ukukhushulwa okunotariweko akusetjenziswa kule ndlela yokuthumela — gcina i-zip ye-GitHub engasayiniweko njengeyokuqala.
privacyDesktopMirrorNote: Ukulanda kwe-macOS yedeskithophu: isibuko se-CDN siyasebenza; i-GitHub Release ihlala iyindlela ebhaliweyo yokubuyela.
privacy: Lokhu kuhlola kuhlala kule khompyutha. Awugcinwa umlando wokuphequlula.
invalid: Faka ikheli elivumelekileko le-HTTP nanyana i-HTTPS.
ignoreRiskBody: Unganikeza amaphasiwedi, imininingwane yokukhokha, nanyana enye idatha yomuntu siqu kulowo olawula leli kheli. Vala ithebhu ngaphambi kokuthayipha nanyana ukukhokha nanyana yini.
nextStepLeave: Phuma kuleli khasi nje — ungakuqhubeki ekhelini olihlolileko.
nextStepNoCredentials: Ungafaki amaphasiwedi, iinombolo zamakhadi, amakhodi we-SMS/imeyili, nanyana enye idatha yomuntu siqu kule sayithi.
nextStepVerifyOfficial: Qinisekisa ngokuzimela: vula isizinda nanyana i-app esemthethweni senhlangano osesithembako (ibhukhimakhi, ikhadi lebhanga, isitolo se-app esaziwa). Ungasebenzisi iingcingo nanyana ama-imeyili akhona ekhasini elisolisako.
nextStepReport: Ngokukhetha: gcina ngezasi umbhalo wesikhatshana wendawo ukuze umsebenzi abuyekeze umshini wohlolo uhlu lwezinsongo oluqondisiweko.
nextStepBlock: Ngokukhetha: vimbela umshini ku-extension nanyana i-app yedeskithophu ye-buusdo ukuze kube nzima ukuwuvula ngephutha.
nextStepLooksReal: Amakhasi wokukhwabanisa avame ukubukeka ehlanzekileko begodu asebenzise i-HTTPS. Ikhwalithi yokubukeka ayifakazeli bonyana isayithi isemthethweni.
honestLimitNoWipe: I-buusdo ayikwazi ukusula ulwazi lomuntu siqu iwebhusayithi eseyiluqoqileko. Tjhugulula amaphasiwedi kusayithi yangempela esemthethweni nanyana ufake nanyana yini, bese ubheka izexwayiso zebhanga/imeyili.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Imiphumela ivela ohlwini oluqondisiweko kanye nezimpawu zekheli ze-buusdo — hhayi isibalo somphakathi sokuthi bangaki abantu ababike isayithi.
honestLimitNoAv: Lena akuyona imkhiqizo yokulwa namagciwane. Ukuvala ithebhu kumisa ukufaka idatha lapha; ayiskeni nanyana ihlanze idivayisi yakho.
actionSensitiveNote: Ungafaki ulwazi olubucayi ngaphandle kokuba unakuqinisekisa ikheli ngomthombo ozimeleko.
feedbackReportExportHint: Umbhalo wesikhatshana ugciniwe. Vula Iinhlelo → Imibhalo yesikhatshana yempendulo ukuze ukhiphe ifayela le-batches/*.json ukuze umsebenzi abuyekeze — akukho okuthunyelwako.
faqNoWipeTitle: Ingabe i-buusdo ingasula idatha isayithi eseyiyithathileko?
faqNoWipeBody: Awa. Tjhugulula amaphasiwedi kusayithi yangempela esemthethweni nanyana kufakwe luthu, bese ubheka izexwayiso zebhanga nanyana ze-imeyili.
faqNoAvBody: Awa. Ukuvala ithebhu kumisa ukufaka idatha eyengeziweko kulelo kheli; ayiskeni nanyana ihlanze idivayisi.
faqNoCrowdTitle: Ingabe amaphuzu avela ezivotini zabanye abasebenzisi?
faqNoCrowdBody: Awa. Imiphumela isebenzisa uhlu lwezinsongo oluqondisiweko lwe-buusdo neempawu zekheli — hhayi isibalo somphakathi sokuthi bangaki abantu ababike lokhu.
protection: Sebenzisa i-extension nanyana i-app yedeskithophu ukuze ubuyekeze uhlu lokuvikela.
currentlyBlocked: ivinjelwe ku-extension nanyana ku-app yedeskithophu nanyana uyengeza lapho.
resetDone: Umlando wendawo, imibhalo yesikhatshana, nokhiye bohlu obudala kusuliwe.
blockListsWebsiteNote: Le webhusayithi ayiphoqeleli uhlu lokuvimbela/lokuthemba (i-extension nedeskithophu kuyenza lokho). Uhlu luhlala kudivayisi.
blockListsOfflinePath: Indlela phakathi kwamadivayisi: khipha nanyana ngenisa i-JSON nanyana i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1 ku-extension nanyana ku-app yedeskithophu. Ideskithophu ingavumelanisa ne-shield-backup.json nge-USB, i-Drive, nanyana i-Syncthing — akukho akhawunti yefu.
listsOfflineIntro: Uhlu lokuvimbela nolokuthemba luhlala kudivayisi ngayinye. Akukho akhawunti yefu ye-buusdo. Sebenzisa ukukhipha/ukungenisa nanyana ukuvumelanisa kwefayela.
listsOfflineStepExport: Ku-extension nanyana ku-app yedeskithophu, khipha i-shield-lists-v1 (i-JSON nanyana i-QR).
listsOfflineStepMove: Kopisha ifayela nanyana skena i-QR kwedivayisi enye (i-USB, i-Drive, umyalezo owuzithumelela wona).
listsOfflineStepImport: Ngenisa kwedivayisi enye. Kungcono umbhali oyedwa ngesikhathi.
listsOfflineDesktopBody: I-app yedeskithophu igcina uhlu njenge-shield-backup.json kufolda yedatha yayo. Ungavumelanisa leyo folda nge-Syncthing, i-Drive, nanyana i-USB. Nanyana amadivayisi amabili abhala ngesikhathi esisodwa, khipha godu kudivayisi oyithembako bese ungenisa kwenye.
accountHint: Ngokukhetha. Vumelanisa uhlu lomuntu siqu lokuvimbela/lokuthemba kuphela phakathi kwewebhusayithi, i-extension, nedeskithophu. Soze kube umlando wokuhlola nanyana ama-URL agcweleko.
accountDisabled: Ukuvumelanisa kwe-akhawunti kucinyiwe kule seva (ACCOUNT_SYNC_ENABLED). Sebenzisa isipele esingaphandle kwe-inthanethi ngezasi, nanyana cela umsebenzi bonyana akuvule ukuvumelanisa.
accountMagicSent: Nanyana lelo kheli lingamukela iposi, isixhumanisi sokungena sithunyelwe (ukuthuthukisa kungabonisa isixhumanisi ngezasi).
accountSyncToggleHint: Nanyana kuvuliwe, okuthi Vumelanisa nje kucindezela begodu kudonsa i-shield-lists-v1. Ukuphuma akusuli uhlu lwefu.
accountStagingPlaceholder: Namathisela i-JSON ye-shield-lists-v1 ukucindezela, nanyana Vumelanisa nje ukudonsa.
accountDeleteConfirm: Sula le akhawunti kanye nesithombe sohlu lwefu? Lokhu akukwazi ukubuyiselwa. Uhlu lwendawo ku-extension/ideskithophu aluthintwa.
accountSignOutNote: Ukuphuma akusuli uhlu lwefu. Ukusula i-akhawunti kuyakwenza lokho.
accountOfflineBackup: Isipele esingaphandle kwe-inthanethi: khipha nanyana ngenisa i-JSON nanyana i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1 ukusuka ku-extension nanyana ku-app yedeskithophu.
accountSyncNeedPrivacy: Khetha Le divayisi kuphela nanyana Ukuhlola amaphutha kokusekela ngaphambi kokuvumelanisa ukulungiselela kohlu kule sayithi.
accountSyncEmpty: Awukho uhlu lwefu okwamanje — namathisela i-JSON bese ucindezela uVumelanisa nje ukulayisha.
accountListsTooMany: Kunezinhlamvu eziningi kakhulu zokuvimbela/zokuthemba ukuvumelanisa kwefu.
accountListsTooLarge: I-JSON yohlu idlula umkhawulo wosayizi wefu.
blockListsPrivacySurfaces: Ku-Ungagcini nhlobo: i-extension isula uhlu lomuntu siqu ku-chrome.storage; i-app yedeskithophu iyabuza ngaphambi kokusula i-shield-backup.json kudiski.

leaveAndBlockSettingsCta: Vula Iinhlelo — uhlu lokuvimbela lusebenza ku-extension / ideskithophu
ambiguousProbeNotPhishing: Ukuvinjelwa kwe-bot nanyana ukuncishiswa kwenhlolo akubona ubufakazi bokukhwabanisa — vula isayithi kusiphequluli esijwayelekileko nanyana usayidinga.
probeBlocked403Detail: Kutholwe i-HTTP 403 (Forbidden). Isayithi yenqabile lokhu kuhlola okuzenzakalelayo — lokho akubona ubufakazi bokukhwabanisa. Zama ikheli kusiphequluli esijwayelekileko nanyana kudingeka.
probeBlocked429Detail: Kutholwe i-HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests). Isayithi inciphise lokhu kuhlola — lokho akubona ubufakazi bokukhwabanisa. Linda bese uzama godu, nanyana vula ikheli kusiphequluli esijwayelekileko.
probeBlocked503Detail: Kutholwe i-HTTP 503 (Service Unavailable). Isayithi nanyana umkhawulo ungase ugcwale — lokho akubona ubufakazi bokukhwabanisa. Zama godu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kusiphequluli esijwayelekileko nanyana kudingeka.
personalListLeaveNote: Ukuphuma kuphakanyiswe uhlu lwakho lomuntu siqu lokuvimbela (i-extension / ideskithophu). Le webhusayithi ayilugcinanga uhlu.

limitationNoThirdParty: Ama-URL awathunyelwa ku-Google Safe Browsing nanyana kwezinye izinsiza zedumela zenkampani yesithathu.

riskLevelHighNote: Iimpawu zexwayiso eziningi ezibhaliweko zidinga ukunakwa ngokushesha.
riskLevelCautionNote: Kutholwe ukungaqiniseki okubalulekileko nanyana iimpawu zexwayiso.
riskLevelLowEvidenceNote: Ayikho insongo eyaziwayo etholwe emithonjeni ehloliweko.
riskLevelUnknownNote: Abukho ubufakazi obanele ukufinyelela esiphethweni esiqinisekileko.
recommendLeaveAndBlock: Phuma begodu uvimbele lesi sizinda (ku-extension nanyana ku-app yedeskithophu)
probeBlockedGenericDetail: Kutholwe i-HTTP {status}. Isayithi ivimbele nanyana inciphise lokhu kuhlola — lokho akubona ubufakazi bokukhwabanisa. Zama ikheli kusiphequluli esijwayelekileko nanyana kudingeka.
faqCommonIntro: Iimpendulo ezimfithsani ngalokho i-buusdo eyikwenzako nalokho engakwenzi — ziwusizo ngaphambi kobana uthembe umphumela we-Misa.
themeHeaderHint: Use the one Appearance button in the header (next to language).
